2609.04198.title: Clean Engineering, Unstable Measurement: A Preregistered Reliability Failure of Black-Box LLM Observers on Shared Endpoints
2609.04198.paper_summary: Language-model judges now gate training data, score generations, and drive leaderboards. The judge is then a measurement instrument, resting on one rarely stated assumption: the same request, sent to the same model name, reads the same tomorrow. We audited that assumption in two preregistered campaigns with every threshold fixed in advance; neither got past validating its instrument. Across 52,988 audited request attempts, same-window repeat rankings agreed at Spearman 0.400 against a required 0.90, and byte-identical next-day replays agreed at 0.78 against a required 0.99, each time with the execution record at ceiling. Three mechanisms explain the gap: a label-to-meaning mapping that biased readouts as strongly as the signal; candidate gaps seven orders of magnitude below the instrument's own noise floor; and byte-identical inputs returning different rankings, a noise that exact-permutation readouts compound. Neither metric substitution nor sampling repaired it on the tested grid. Preregistered follow-ups bound the problem: waiting did not help on the days sampled (0.805 versus 0.800, replicated over five further days); switching providers did not help (four providers share the floor, medians 0.74 to 0.88, predicted by none of the metadata fields they expose); self-hosting on batch-invariant kernels helped only while the server was quiet; and on constructed errors with known gaps, the readout's separation tracks error type, not size. We distill the evidence into a three-level snapshot-identity ladder, eight design rules, and a reporting checklist; a pilot at roughly 2% of the study's call volume would have exposed both unreachable gates in advance. All results concern externally measured behaviour on shared serving infrastructure. On a shared endpoint, a model name is not a frozen instrument; a preregistered evaluation must measure its instrument before freezing any gate on it.
2609.04198.paper_summary_zh: 語言模型評判現在控制訓練數據、評分生成結果並推動排行榜。評判因此成為一種測量工具，基於一個鮮少被提及的假設：相同的請求，發送到相同的模型名稱，明天的結果會是一樣的。我們在兩個預註冊的活動中審核了這一假設，所有閾值均提前固定；但都未能通過其工具的驗證。在52,988次審核的請求嘗試中，相同窗口的重複排名以0.400的斯皮爾曼相關係數達成一致，而所需的為0.90；而位元組完全相同的次日重播則以0.78達成一致，所需的為0.99，每次執行記錄均達到上限。有三個機制解釋了這一差距：標籤到意義的映射使讀數受到強烈偏見；候選差距低於工具自身噪聲底線七個數量級；以及位元組完全相同的輸入返回不同的排名，這是一種噪聲，精確排列的讀數會加劇這種情況。無論是度量替代還是取樣在測試的網格上都無法修復它。預註冊的後續研究界定了問題：在抽樣的日子裡等待並沒有幫助（0.805對0.800，並在五天內重複）；更換供應商也沒有幫助（四個供應商共享同一底線，中位數為0.74到0.88，無一由他們所公開的元數據字段預測）；在批次不變的內核上自我托管僅在伺服器安靜時有所幫助；而在具有已知差距的構造錯誤上，讀數的分離追蹤錯誤類型，而非大小。我們將證據提煉為三層快照身份梯度、八條設計規則和一份報告檢查表；在研究的呼叫量約2%的試點將提前暴露兩個無法到達的閘門。所有結果均涉及在共享服務基礎設施上外部測量的行為。在共享端點上，模型名稱不是一個固定的工具；預註冊的評估必須在凍結任何閘門之前測量其工具。
2609.04198.author: Haoyaun Zhu et.al.
